messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'm building a Console panel called "Routing Controls" to show how SDK/API hints affect routing and fallback chains. Thinking of exposing two headers and an SDK routingOptions param. Feedback?

jana: Major Q: if a client sets a tier hint, can that be used to bypass quotas or SLAs?

pranav: Short answer: no. Client hints are advisory only. Billing and SLA enforcement come from the identity tier in the control plane. Hints can influence routing decisions but must not elevate privileges.

li: Implementation approach: accept X-Redwood-Region-Hint and X-Redwood-Routing-Hint for routing. Accept X-Redwood-Debug only if token verifies and caller is allowlisted. Emit telemetry whenever hinted values differ from identity values (mismatch audit).

alex: Proposed header examples:
```
X-Redwood-Region-Hint: eu-central-1
X-Redwood-Routing-Hint: prefer_local;tier_hint=starter;allow_fallback=true
X-Redwood-Debug: trace:eyJhbGciOi... (dev-only short-lived token)
```

alex: SDK surface idea: routingOptions = { preferRegion?, tierHint?, allowFallback=false, debugToken? } — defaults: allowFallback=false, tierHint ignored for routing if identity tier is higher.

pranav: SDK guardrails: default allowFallback=false, debugToken only in server SDKs (strip in browser builds), and require explicit dev-mode opt-in.

jana: Console UX: show a routing preview for customer+route — fields: effective_region, selected_variant, fallback_chain, decision_reasons, and a small "hints applied" diff. Include one-click open of raw trace for support. :mag:

li: Telemetry contract (naming): event: routing.decision with tags: customer_hash, route, effective_region, variant, reason, hinted_region, hinted_tier, identity_tier, hinted_applied, sample_rate. Example event payload (pseudo):
```
{"customer_hash":"h_abc123","route":"/v1/chat","effective_region":"eu-central-1","variant":"quant-v2","reason":"preferred-region-available","hinted_region":"eu-central-1","hinted_tier":"starter","identity_tier":"enterprise","hinted_applied":true}
```

pranav: Important: no raw account identifiers in telemetry. Hash IDs, cap high-cardinality fields (tier values enumerated), and sample debug traces.

ops-bot: deploy-check: routing-controls feature flag OFF in prod; tests: 11/13 passed (routing hint e2e flaky) :robot_face:

alex: Rollout plan: server-side feature flag + admin opt-in per account. SDK header acceptance disabled by default for new customers. Any admin override that expands cross-region routing requires a security review (data residency).

jana: I'll do Console mockups. UX will include a toggle "Apply client routing hints (dev only)" with inline help explaining hints do not override SLAs. Also add an audit row for mismatches.

li: Metrics to surface: per-account hint_mismatch_rate and fallback_frequency on customer dashboard. Add alerting: mismatch_rate > 1% or fallback_rate > 5% over 24h.

alex: Debug trace rules: debugToken must be a signed, short-lived JWT scoped to account+env. Verify signature and allowlist. Tag telemetry debug_trace=true when used, sample at 1% unless account in beta.

ci-bot: build 6840: unit tests passed, routing-e2e flaky on cross-region fallback, added extra logs for investigation.

alex: I'll draft an RFC with: header contract, SDK surface, telemetry schema (snake_case), and Console mocks. Will ping @security and @support for the review checklist.

retention-bot: note: thread will be archived after 30d inactivity. :lock:
